title: policy/v1
description: policy.json at the graph root (F15-R3, Q2; D-32 v3.17, D-35): the one visible switch for the steward rule. An absent file means the rule is not enforced; the file is curator-owned (path role `policy`, changeable only in curator mode) and flipped by one pull request naming the evidence — never a quiet relaxation in either direction. Its state is published at the top of targets/index.json. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

enforced.description: Whether an open-track target with no active steward refuses claims (F15-R4; D-6 v3.17).

since.description: The day the current state was set.

evidence.description: What justified the current state: for enforcement, the calibration record (Stages v3.17).
